page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.8xlarge is a general purpose server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is provisioned with 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz using x86_64 architecture. Memory configuration totals 64.0 GB of RAM, equating to an allocation of 2.0 GB of memory per dedicated vCPU. This 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio provides dense core capacity for compute-leaning requirements.

The instance does not include integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators. Any persistent or ephemeral storage operations require attaching remote block storage across the network interface. Network connectivity operates with a baseline bandwidth capacity of 8 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance profile.

By offering dedicated CPU allocation without bundled local NVMe storage or physical accelerators, the instance optimizes cost efficiency for workloads prioritizing raw execution threads over massive memory footprints or localized disk throughput. The configuration is suited for tasks such as distributed build farms, CI/CD runners, containerized web serving, batch data processing, and microservice hosts.

The instance does not include local disk storage or physical GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage solutions supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. With its focus on multi-threaded compute density over memory volume, ecs.u2a-c1m2.8xlarge maintains qualitative cost efficiency for organizations scaling concurrent workloads. It is tailored for application profiles such as batch processing, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, container orchestration, and parallelized backend web services.
